name: UPLIFT L-Shaped Standing Desk, 3-Leg, Walnut Laminate 1", 80"Mx60"R, Return on Left Side, V2 C-Frame White

dimensions.raw: Configurator: "UPL934-walnut-lam-80MX60R"; Desktop Size "M = Main side desktop width. R = Return side desktop width. ... The Main side desktop depth is 30" and the Return side desktop depth is 27.5"." with "80"Mx60"R +$185" selected; Return Side "Return on Left Side" selected. Specifications, L-Shaped Standing Desk SKU: UPL934: "WIDTHS Main: 60" to 80" Return: 30" or 48""; "DEPTH Main: 30" Return: 27.5""; "HEIGHT RANGE Height range with 1" thick desktop: V3 frame: 22.6" to 48.7" V2 frame: 25.3" to 50.9" V2-Comm frame: 22.6" to 48.7""
dimensions.source: upliftdesk.com configurator and Specs tab, read in Claude in Chrome 2026-10-24. w = M, 80 (the main top, along the wall); d = R, 60 (the return side overall: the main's 30" depth plus the 30" return top, since the spec table's Return is 30" or 48" against the configurator's 60" or 78" R); notch 52.5 x 30 = (80 - 27.5) x (60 - 30), on the right as drawn because the return is on the user's left; h = the V2 frame's maximum in the spec table, 50.9 (the frame section's own text says the V2 frame runs 24.5" to 50.1")

images.caption: main: The L-shaped desktop, paired with UPLIFT storage accessories such as the Deep Desk Drawer
second: Three motors. Superior L-Shaped stability. Synchronized precision motors in each leg. 535 lb lift capacity
third: Solid. Sturdy. Stable. Wobble-free design featuring TremorGuard feet

notes: Andrew's link, 2026-10-24: "add standing desks for consideration for the office, this is large but try to accommodate something like this". As configured on the page: Walnut Laminate 1"; 80"Mx60"R (+$185); Return on Left Side (reversible: "You may choose to use the return on either side during assembly."); Grommets 2 Covers Black; Frame Color & Type V2 C-Frame White (V3 White is +$100 and runs 22.6" to 48.7"); Basic Display Angled Keypad Black. Price: $1334 regular; the page shows $1234 with "Save $100" and "Sale ends 11/02/2026. Use coupon code FALL at checkout." "Ships the same day, order by 3pm Central"; free shipping in the contiguous USA, 1-4 business days; assembly service from $119 per L-shaped desk; 30-day returns; 15-year warranty. Three motors, 535 lb lifting capacity. 4.9 stars (2,322 reviews). Other sizes on the same page: 60"Mx60"R, 72"Mx60"R (+$120), 60"Mx78"R (+$170), 72"Mx78"R (+$290), 80"Mx78"R (+$355). Photos: three of the page's own product images, served from UPLIFT's store folder on BigCommerce's CDN (cdn11.bigcommerce.com/s-l85bzww3lo/), allowed with upliftdesk.com by Andrew on 2026-10-24 ("yea ok"); they show a black frame, while the one configured is white. Fit: back-bedroom/e, the main along the 152" left wall (y 30-110) with the return at its south end, the four 32" screens on it (three across the main, the outer two angled in about 30 degrees, about 77"; the fourth on the return); the job desk stays a separate MITTZON on the right wall (F-62). It leaves no room for the guest chair bed: opened, the bed would run into the return. Flags: none (50.9" is under F-23's 78"; ships flat-packed, F-22). rooms: back-bedroom, from the brief.
